name: shesha
label: Shesha house kit (LandBank / Requirements Studio)

provenance.source: Requirements Studio (offline).html :root block, 76 tokens, header comment 'LandBank Desktop Web — Design Tokens'; cross-checked against shesha-house-design-standard.md sections 1.1-1.3, 3.1-3.5
provenance.note: This IS the house kit. Requirements Studio is branded Boxfusion in its header yet every colour in it is a --lb-* variable and its own module comment says it was forked from the LandBank kit — there is no separate Boxfusion palette. The LandBank and WCG HTML exports contain ZERO :root blocks and zero CSS custom properties, so nothing here was extracted from them; the measured literals come from the design standard.

microLabel.note: 153 instances across the reference corpus, zero in the current Shesha output. The single highest-signal, lowest-cost design element available.

spacing.note: The kit's own --lb-sp-* 4px scale is ASPIRATIONAL and the shipped build does not honour it. Gaps are validated against this declared set, never against 'multiples of 4' — a 4px rule rejects the reference design itself.

elevation.shadowCardNote: LB CARDS ARE FLAT and the markup never emits a card shadow property at all. This is a philosophy, not a value — every surface consumes shadowCard.
elevation.shadowOverlayNote: :root declares this at 0.08, but the shipped markup uses 0.18 (28 occurrences). Declared vs measured; the measured value wins.

statusModelNote: Solid fill carries the colour, text is #ffffff, over the 16-value referenceListRamp below. NOT interchangeable with WCG's tint model, where the background is tinted and the text is dark — migrating between them changes which end of the pair carries the colour, which a token cannot express.
referenceListRampNote: Seed a Shesha reference list's item colours from this. refListStatus takes its fill ONLY from the item's own colour [R-036] — measured: all 5 reference lists in boxfusion.test have empty colours on all 26 items, so refListStatus renders grey there today.
